sections.label: Store API
sections.description: The sales channel this environment reads products, carts and customers from. Shopware admin → Sales Channels → your channel → API access.

sections.label: Admin API
sections.description: An integration for what the Store API does not offer: the media library, the sales channel's currency and language, the customer's own product review (role permission
), and before Shopware 6.6.10.5 which customer custom fields a customer may write. Shopware admin → Settings → System → Integrations.

sections.label: Storefront
sections.description: The Shopware storefront where the LaioutrConnector plugin is installed.

fields.name: storefrontUrl
fields.label: Storefront address
fields.description: Needed for checkout, registration, password recovery and newsletter sign-up. Shopware builds the links in its mails from it, so it must be a domain of the sales channel.

fields.name: checkoutLoginCallbackUrl
fields.label: Return address after a login in checkout
fields.description: Leave empty to return to the storefront the customer came from. Set the project's login route when customers sign in through an external identity provider.

fields.name: checkoutLogoutCallbackUrl
fields.label: Return address after a logout in checkout
fields.description: Leave empty to return to the storefront the customer came from. Set the identity provider's logout route so that a logout in checkout also ends the external session.

fields.name: dimensionUnit
fields.label: Unit of width, height and length
fields.description: The unit the shop enters product measures in. Shopware's admin labels them millimetres; choose centimetres when the shop's data holds centimetres.

fields.name: customFields
fields.label: Custom fields
fields.description: The Shopware custom fields the storefront may read, per entity: product, variant, category and customer, each with an include list of field names, where * matches any run of characters. Nothing is exposed while this is empty. Custom fields often hold purchasing or ERP data, so list the fields the storefront shows rather than *. A product with variants usually keeps its fields on the variant, so list those under variant.
